mapper.select: select max(bar_id) from corgi_bar_detail where bar_id like concat(#{prefix}, '%')

select bar_id barId, bar_name barName, `address`, `lat`, `lng`, `tel`, `range`, `logo`, `status`, `city`, `start_time` startTime, `end_time` endTime, `spending`, `qr_code` qrCode, `ctime` from corgi_bar_detail
where `status` = #{status}

select bar_id barId, bar_name barName, `address`, `lat`, `lng`, `tel`, `range`, `logo`, `status`, `city`, `account`, `password`, `start_time` startTime, `end_time` endTime, `spending`, `qr_code` qrCode, `ctime` from corgi_bar_detail
where `status` = #{status}

select b.bar_id barId, b.bar_name barName, b.address, b.lat, b.lng, b.tel, b.range, b.logo, b.status, b.ctime, '酒吧' type, b.`start_time` startTime, b.`end_time` endTime, b.`spending`, b.`qr_code` qrCode, b.city from corgi_bar_detail b
left join corgi_user_follow f on f.follow_user_id = b.bar_id and f.is_deleted = '0'
where b.status = '1'
and b.city = #{city}
order by st_distance_sphere(point(#{lng},#{lat}),point(b.lng,b.lat))
group by b.bar_id order by count(f.user_id) desc
select max(c.activity_id) from corgi_bar_detail d left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.creator_id = bar_id where d.city = #{city} group by d.bar_id order by count(1) desc limit #{size}

select c.activity_id from corgi_bar_detail b left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.creator_id = b.bar_id where d.status = '1' order by st_distance_sphere(point(#{lng}, #{lat}), point(b.lng, b.lat)), c.ctime desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select bar_id barId, bar_name barName, `address`, `lat`, `lng`, `tel`, `range`, `logo`, `status`, `account`, `city`, `start_time` startTime, `end_time` endTime, `spending`, `qr_code` qrCode, `detail`, `ctime` from corgi_bar_detail where bar_id = #{barId}
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow f where f.follow_user_id = #{barId} and f.is_deleted = '0' and user_id in ('${userIds}')

select bar_id barId, bar_name barName, `address`, `lat`, `lng`, `tel`, `range`, `logo`, `status`, `city`, `account`, `start_time` startTime, `end_time` endTime, `spending`, `qr_code` qrCode, `ctime` from corgi_bar_detail where 1=1
and (bar_name like concat('%',#{bar.barName},'%') or address like concat('%',#{bar.address},'%'))
and `status` = #{bar.status}
order by st_distance_sphere(point(#{bar.lng},#{bar.lat}),point(lng,lat))

select bar_id barId, bar_name barName, `address`, `lat`, `lng`, `tel`, `range`, `logo`, `status`, `city`, `start_time` startTime, `end_time` endTime, `detail`, `spending`, `qr_code` qrCode, `ctime` from corgi_bar_detail where `account` = #{account} and `password` = #{password}
